## Production Systems & Architectural Case Studies (22 Systems)
- [J-Gallery Windows Media Management System](https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/projects/j-gallery): High-performance Windows media management system using Electron, React, TypeScript, multi-threaded worker_threads, FFmpeg video thumbnail pipeline with disk caching, incremental mtimeMs scan skipping, GPU rasterization, and deep EXIF hardware metadata decoding.
- [TwinLink Continuum & RelayHost](https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/projects/twinlink): High-performance Windows P2P PC linking and Internet relay platform (v1.4.2 Continuum / v1.3.0 RelayHost) for zero-latency local LAN clipboard synchronization and NAT traversal.
- [PropKart — Enterprise Real Estate CRM & OS](https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/projects/propkart): Apple-inspired operating system with 2ms Isar NoSQL reads, Natural Language AI Search, SDK 36, 123 additive PostgreSQL migrations, dynamic app_config, and 100/100 security score.
- [PropKart Broker Portal](https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/projects/propkart-broker) (Live: https://broker.nbpropertytech.com): Enterprise broker onboarding suite with two-tier RERA approval workflows, multi-field requirement matchmaking overhaul, standalone PropKartBrokerPortal.exe Windows desktop build, and PostgreSQL Migrations v1.26–v1.27.

- [GitSphere Desktop](https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/projects/gitsphere): Visual Git control center with 4-stage visual pipeline and multi-account switcher.
- [DevSync P2P Engine](https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/projects/devsync): Cryptographic peer-to-peer file transfer engine with Ed25519 identity and zero-retention Vercel relay.
